contrastive_learning.name: contriever
contrastive_learning.summary: Contriever是一种基于对比学习的文档检索模型，无需人工标注即可从海量文本中精准检索相关内容。其核心创新在于通过对比学习训练文本编码器：对同一文本生成增强版本作为正样本，其他文本作为负样本，从而学习判别性文本表示。该方法摆脱了对标注数据的依赖，可应用于构建智能检索系统，通过向量空间相似度匹配实现精准语义搜索，或集成至现有系统增强语义理解能力。
contrastive_learning.summary_en: Contriever is a contrastive learning model that retrieves relevant documents from large collections without requiring explicit relevance labels during training. It trains by maximizing agreement between differently augmented views of the same text while minimizing agreement with other texts, creating robust text representations. You can use it for semantic search applications by encoding queries and documents into shared embedding space, then finding nearest neighbors - perfect for building your own document retrieval system or enhancing existing search capabilities with semantic understanding.
